Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps

Hi Alex,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for taking the discovery call with us. Based on what you shared (high-throughput inference for your customer-facing chat widgets + a strict p95 latency requirement), the next best step is a short dedicated capacity sizing call where we align on concurrency, throughput (tokens/sec), p95 latency targets, and any on-prem/VPC constraints.

Proposed agenda (30–45 min):
- Quick recap of current discovery notes (5 min)
- Expected workload profile: concurrency, QPS/tokens/sec, seq length distribution (10 min)
- Sizing options: GPU types, pools, and autoscale/burst policies (15 min)
- Action items: mutual action plan and timeline (5 min)

I’m available this week:
- Thu 11/12: 11:00–12:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 11/13: 09:00–11:00 PT

Can you confirm who from your side should join (SRE, infra, procurement)? I’ve attached a short capacity template you can optionally fill out to speed the call.

Attachments: capacity-template.xlsx (columns: expected_concurrency, avg_tokens_per_request, p95_latency_ms, model_variants, peak_daily_calls)

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite for the 11/12 15:00 PT slot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0198

Quick answers to the template fields so you can prep:
- Expected concurrency: steady 30, burst to 120 for short periods
- Avg tokens per request: 120 tokens
- Peak tokens/sec (per app): ~6,000 tokens/sec across models (combined)
- p95 latency target: <= 250 ms (user-facing chat)

Can you send a calendar invite and any pre-read (short) that we should review?
